title: Use string resources in AddMedicationDialog composable
name: AddMedicationDialog
description: Replace hardcoded literals with stringResource() calls. Logic/state unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Dialog title uses add_a_medication (shared with the FAB contentDescription elsewhere)
Name field uses name_label, dose field uses default_dose_label
'Minimum time between doses' label uses min_interval_label
Confirm button uses the shared add resource, dismiss uses cancel
